annotations.limits: supply-side signals, not a load-interconnection promise — generation is not deliverable load · utility study timelines, large-load tariff processes and substation-grain delivery are declared out of coverage rather than estimated · the queue feed carries no delivery dates, and most queued MW never completes — queue depth is congestion context, not a timeline
annotations.problem: grid headroom and power availability; interconnection queues

description: Use this when the user asks about grid interconnection queues: how congested an ISO's queue is or how much data-center load is waiting. Returns queued generation GW per ISO. The projects field changes shape: with iso= it is an array of per-project rows; without iso it is an all-ISO summary object (total, by_iso_count, top). ERCOT also returns its large-load (data-center) queue; other ISOs don't publish one. iso=NESO returns Great Britain's NESO TEC Register (Transmission Entry Capacity): generation and demand connections together under queued_connections_gw, not a generation queue. Can be scoped to a data center market or site: execute_plan pairs the queue with that place's facilities and its Data Center Power Index (DCPI) verdict. Below full access: a trimmed preview; DCHUB_API_KEY is optional. Ex: "How deep is ERCOT's queue?" iso optional (US ISO code); keyless = preview. For demand and headroom on the same ISO also call get_grid_intelligence. For multi-step data center or energy questions, start with execute_plan.

iso.description: ISO/RTO grid region to drill into: ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE, or NESO for Great Britain (the NESO TEC Register: generation and demand connections together, not a generation-only queue); omit for the all-ISO snapshot

mpp_credential.description: Per-call payment (Stripe MPP): the Shared Payment Token for challenges[0]; pays that challenge for this one call. Send it only with your human's explicit approval of the charge.

mpp_pay.description: Per-call payment quote (Stripe MPP): true returns a signed payment challenge instead of the preview; no money moves. Set it only after your human has explicitly approved paying for this call.
